annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/6 of 4 January 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/6 of 4 January 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending Decision 2021/1182 to add references of revised harmonised standards (biological evaluation, sterilisation, aseptic processing, ISO 13485 quality management, symbols, home light therapy equipment) supporting the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745, giving presumption of conformity. Not AI-related.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds nine harmonised standard references to the Annex of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182.
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
Covers EN ISO 13485:2016/A11:2021 and EN IEC 60601-2-83:2020/A11:2021 among others.
